Context: B. Seniority of Promotees

- 2.3. Promotions without Quotas.In cases where promotions are made from multiple grades without fixed quotas due to a small number of posts in the promotion grade, a combined eligibility list is prepared. The list considers the inter se seniority of candidates from various feeder grades. The recruitment rules issued by the cadre controlling authorities specify the criteria for preparing the combined eligibility list, such as the date of completion of qualifying service in the relevant and feeder-to-feeder
